features: YOUR HOME, YOUR STAGE: Bring the cinema home with Noise Homestage 5.2.4 — a flagship sound system engineered to surround you with immersive, room-filling audio and turn every movie, match and song into a larger-than-life experience

TRUE 5.2.4 DOLBY ATMOS: Experience a three-dimensional soundstage with True Dolby Atmos, 5 front channels, 4 physical up-firing height channels and 2 dedicated subwoofers that create a more immersive layer of sound from around and above you

700W POWER WITH DUAL SUBWOOFERS: Unleash up to 700W peak power with two 6.5-inch wired subwoofers engineered to deliver powerful, balanced bass across your listening space — from cinematic explosions to deep music beats

FOUR UP-FIRING HEIGHT CHANNELS WITH WIRELESS REAR SPEAKERS: Physical up-firing drivers bounce sound off the ceiling for overhead effects, while wireless rear satellite speakers expand the soundstage around your seating area for an immersive surround experience

CINEMA-READY CONNECTIVITY: Connect effortlessly through HDMI eARC/ARC, Optical, USB, AUX or Bluetooth 5.3. Choose from Movie, Music and News EQ modes, with dedicated 12-level bass and treble adjustment to fine-tune your sound
